title: INDIA bloc announces Delhi protest over voting rights and Election Commission
seoTitle: Delhi march against CEC Gyanesh Kumar

tea.why: Protesters allege irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and question the integrity of the Election Commission.
tea.want: Demand free and fair elections, the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, and the scrapping of voter roll revisions.
tea.changed: Oct 10: Congress and opposition INDIA bloc announced a major protest march in Delhi for Monday, October 12.

summary: The opposition INDIA bloc has announced a major protest march in New Delhi to safeguard voting rights and demand the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Organised by the Congress and partner parties, the planned demonstration follows widespread allegations of irregularities and massive deletions in the electoral rolls stemming from the Special Intensive Revision exercise. Opposition leaders announced they will continue agitations until the electoral process is reformed. Ahead of the scheduled Monday march, authorities have faced criticism over police crackdowns and the detention of several political figures and protesters attempting to demonstrate in the capital.
demands: Removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Scrapping of the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls
response: Delhi Police detained several political leaders, activists, and protesters who attempted to march to Jantar Mantar, and implemented security restrictions including the closure of metro stations.

updates.text: Congress leader KC Venugopal announced that the INDIA bloc will stage a major protest in Delhi on Monday.
